description_en: Calls BatchSetDcdnIpaDomainConfigs to configure multiple IP Application Accelerator (IPA) domain names in a batch
description_zh: 调用BatchSetDcdnIpaDomainConfigs批量配置IPA层应用加速域名
name: BatchSetDcdnIpaDomainConfigs

parameters.help_en:
The IPA domain names. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,). Note the following configuration limits:
The value of "Number of domain names" × "Number of Functions" must be less than or equal to 20. For example:
If the number of Functions configured at a time is 20, you can specify only one domain name at a time.
If the number of Functions configured at a time is 1, you can specify up to 20 domain names at a time
parameters.help_zh:
IPA层应用加速域名，多个域名用英文逗号（,）分隔。注意以下配置限制：
“域名数量” 乘以 “Functions 数量” 的值小于等于 20。例如：
如果单次配置的Functions 数量为20，那么单次只能传1个域名。
如果单次配置的Functions 数量为1，那么单次可以传20个域名
parameters.name: domain_names

parameters.help_en:
The list of features. Note the following configuration limits:
The value of "Number of domain names" × "Number of Functions" must be less than or equal to 20. For example:
If the number of Functions configured at a time is 20, you can specify only one domain name at a time.
If the number of Functions configured at a time is 1, you can specify up to 20 domain names at a time.

Format:
```[{"functionArgs":[{"argName":"Configuration name","argValue":"Configuration value"}],"functionName":"Feature name"}]```
parameters.help_zh:
功能列表。注意以下配置限制：
“域名数量” 乘以 “Functions 数量” 的值小于等于 20。例如：
如果单次配置的Functions 数量为20，那么单次只能传1个域名。
如果单次配置的Functions 数量为1，那么单次可以传20个域名。

格式如下：
```[{"functionArgs":[{"argName":"配置名称","argValue":"配置值"}],"functionName":"功能名称"}]```
parameters.name: functions
